title: Firewall: Playmaker's Deck (lore build)
summary: Firewall is Playmaker's ace line in VRAINS. Its modern Main Deck cards (Firewall Defenser, Firewall Phantom, Firewall Guardian) are here, and the rest of the Main Deck is the real Cyberse cards Playmaker plays from season 2 on, when Firewall Dragon becomes his ace.

summary.title: Who's in it, and why
points: Firewall Defenser and Firewall Phantom: 2023 support that triggers when used as Cyberse Link material. Defenser calls another Firewall, and Phantom searches a Cynet Spell/Trap.
Playmaker's Cyberse: Backup Secretary, Clock Wyvern, Widget Kid, Cyberse White Hat, Degrade Buster, Dotscaper, ROM Cloudia and Cyberse Gadget.
His Cynet cards: Cynet Mining, Universe, Backdoor, Fusion and Ritual, with Cyberse Magician for Cynet Ritual and Cynet Circuit for the Firewall Links.
Extra Deck: every Firewall Dragon, plus Cyberse Clock Dragon, Decode Talker, Link Spider and Proxy Dragon.

summary.title: How it plays
points: Backup Secretary, Widget Kid and Clock Wyvern turn one summon into several Link materials, and Firewall Defenser and Guardian come back when used.

Firewall Dragon Darkfluid and Singularity grow with each Ritual, Fusion, Synchro and Xyz Cyberse in the GY. Cyberse Magician, Cyberse Clock Dragon, Firewall Saber Dragon and Firewall eXceed Dragon are one of each.
Cyberse Synchron is the Tuner for Firewall Saber Dragon. Most Firewall effects lock you to Cyberse summons for the turn.

main: Firewall Defenser
As Cyberse Link material, calls another Firewall from the Deck; shields Firewalls from the GY.
Firewall Phantom
As Cyberse Link material, searches a Cynet Spell/Trap; recycles a Cyberse.
Firewall Guardian
Returns after being Link material; stops a Link-on-Link attack.
Backup Secretary
Summons itself while you control a Cyberse.
Clock Wyvern
Halves its ATK for a Clock Token; Cyberse Clock Dragon material.
Widget Kid
Summons a Cyberse from the hand when summoned.
Cyberse White Hat
Summons itself next to two same-Type monsters; shrinks theirs as Link material.
Degrade Buster
Banishes two Cyberse from the GY to summon itself; banishes a bigger monster.
Dotscaper
Returns when sent to the GY or banished.
ROM Cloudia
Recovers a Cyberse; calls one from the Deck when destroyed.
Cyberse Gadget
Revives a Level 2 or lower; leaves a Gadget Token.
Cyberse Synchron
Tuner: doubles a monster's Level for Firewall Saber Dragon.
Cyberse Magician
Ritual: halves your damage and draws attacks and targeting.
Cynet Mining
Discards to search a Level 4 or lower Cyberse.
Cynet Fusion
Fusion Summons Cyberse Clock Dragon, using a Link from the GY.
Cynet Ritual
Ritual Spell for Cyberse Magician; makes two tokens from the GY.
Cynet Backdoor
Banishes a Cyberse to search a weaker one; it returns to attack directly.
Cynet Universe
Field Spell: pumps Links; shuffles a monster from a GY back.
Cynet Circuit
Fills a Firewall Link's zones from the GY; revives a Firewall Link at low LP.
extra: Firewall Dragon
Link-4: bounces cards per co-linked monster; summons a Cyberse when its zone empties.
Firewall Dragon Singularity
Newest Link-6: bounces their cards per summoning type you have.
Firewall Dragon Darkfluid - Neo Tempest Terahertz
Link-5: negates their monster effects in battle; attacks per Attribute.
Firewall Dragon Darkfluid
Link-5: counters per Cyberse summoning type; negates monster effects.
Firewall eXceed Dragon
Rank 4: grows with linked Links; revives a Link-4 Cyberse.
Firewall Saber Dragon
Newest Synchro: recovers a Cyberse; searches an A.I. Spell as material.
Cyberse Clock Dragon
Fusion of Clock Wyvern and Links: mills for ATK; protects your other monsters.
Decode Talker
Playmaker's first ace Link-3: grows per linked monster; negates targeting.
Link Spider
Link-1: summons a small Normal Monster where it points.
Proxy Dragon
Link-2: sends a linked monster away to save your card.
Cyberse Wicckid
Link-2: immune to battle/effect destruction while pointing to a monster; banishes a Cyberse from GY to search a Cyberse Tuner.
